name: ghq-sector
description: Node.js CLI for AI-assisted and human-curated ghq workspaces with categorized symlinks, portable config paths, and a local config editor.
author: ts-76

scripts.test: vitest run --maxWorkers 1 --exclude "ui/**" && bun run --cwd ui test
scripts.build-ui: bun install --cwd ui && bun run --cwd ui build
scripts.sync-ui-dist: mkdir -p dist/ui-dist && rm -rf dist/ui-dist/assets && cp -R ui/dist/* dist/ui-dist/
scripts.build: bun run build-ui && bun run sync-ui-dist && bun run build-bin
scripts.audit: bun audit --audit-level=moderate && bun audit --cwd ui --audit-level=moderate && npm audit --audit-level=moderate
